text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 1307 Dundas Street West.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application for the proposed boulevard café located at 1307 Dundas Street West on the condition that the bike ring be relocated.
